note: HAND-MADE DEVELOPMENT FIXTURE for S5 and S8, not S4 output. It puts every op of module3_v1_translated_unitops.json on the one chip this pair of stages is developed against, chip/module3_v1_translated.json, so the grouping and the protocol can be checked against a chip that already exists and is already built. A real partition.json comes from S4 and usually has several chips and the hand-offs between them.

llm.note: Written by hand as an S5/S8 development fixture.

chips.reason: Every op happens to the same capsules in the same trap, at temperatures one thermal zone covers, so nothing forces a cut.
chips.note: The chip is an existing hand-made one, so S6 and S7 have nothing to do here; S5 and S8 are the stages under test.

unresolved.question: What carries the capsules on from this chip is the next module's business, and this fixture stops here.
